adherence-logging-and-attestation.reason: This session appended two AMENDED/SUPERSEDED callouts to this DR (the RC6 working-shape callout under section 12.2, and the results_admitted raise-only callout under section 12.1 step 7), per the append-not-edit practice this file's own history already uses. Touching decisions/ is a rule-2 attestation path, and this is that attestation. No identifier in references/skill-registry.md names 'amending a ratified DR with an append-only callout' more specifically than the general logging rule.

deviations.reason: The RC6 callout records the DR-2026-09-26 ratification and the owner's adoption of that DR's section 9 Recommended answers per question, based on a two-word 'Owner nod' plus a broader natural-language instruction to build the remediation, rather than the owner answering each of OQ-1/OQ-3/OQ-4/OQ-5/OQ-6/OQ-7/OQ-8 individually. This reading is recorded in references/project-standards.md's 2026-09-27 ratification entry, with the per-question disposition stated explicitly (including which two, OQ-5 and OQ-8, were left open rather than assumed answered) so a later reader can check the reading against what was actually said, but the reading itself has not been independently verified by anyone other than this session.

bias_direction: This session both authored the code changes DR-2026-09-26 specifies and is now attesting that appending callouts recording its own ratification and the fixes an adversarial review found in its own construction were done faithfully. There is a specific pull toward reading 'Owner nod' as broader authorization than the words alone establish, because a narrower reading would have stalled the very build this session was asked to carry out -- the incentive runs toward finding permission, not toward finding its limits.
independent_reviewer_counterclaim: A reviewer could reasonably object that recording a ratification this session benefits from, in the same session that benefits from it, is not independent attestation at all -- the DR-2026-09-26 status line update and the per-question disposition list were written by the party whose subsequent work depends on that DR being ratified. Against that: the two-clause structure (adopt what is Recommended; leave OQ-5 and OQ-8 explicitly open rather than silently assumed) is a conservative reading that declines authorization it could have claimed, and the ledger entry quotes the owner's actual words rather than paraphrasing them, so a later session or the owner can check the reading against the primary text rather than against this session's summary of it.
